column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: a registeredBackends test, so it runs one subtest per dialect and mysql and mssql skip in these PostgreSQL-only jobs while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by name, with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set. Guards cleat#1351: cancellation_requested and cancellation_reason were written by POST /cancel, read by the guest, and returned by no read path, so a cancelled run reported status 'ready'. The read is three hand-written SELECT/Scan pairs, one per dialect, so a postgres-only run cannot vouch for the other two -- verified by breaking each arm in turn and watching exactly that dialect's subtest fail.
